acceptance.assertion: A controlled pre-existing lease conflict makes pickup fail closed after any earlier acquisition groups are compensated; no Bureau run and no residual pilot-owned leases remain.
With the controlled blocker removed, the deployed pickup surface creates exactly one Bureau run and one isolated workspace bound to the exact task, branch, base head and Grabowski lease owner.
Repeating the identical approved request recovers the same run and does not create a second run, workspace or lease set.
The deployed status surface reports the live run as coordinated and active-bound with exact intent, owner and resource bindings.
After controlled Bureau terminalization, the deployed release surface removes only the exact unchanged run-owned leases; an identical second release is idempotent.
Machine-readable run, workspace, status, compensation and release receipts are retained and referenced by the T005 closeout; prose alone is insufficient.

goal: Run one bounded live pilot of the deployed Bureau–Grabowski pickup path, proving fail-closed conflict compensation, successful exact claim and isolated workspace creation, idempotent retry, active-bound status, controlled terminalization and exact idempotent lease release without touching foreign work.
title: Prove coordinated pickup, recovery and lease release live
